author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/04_What are Biosafety cabinets , biosafety cabinet in microbiology laboratory biosa（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 生物安全柜：护人、护环境、护样品
points.K5: 一级柜：前面敞开，向里吸风
points.K7: 二级柜：最常用，三方面都护
points.K9: 二级柜：过滤加气流，保持无菌
points.K13: 三级柜：手套口和传递窗
points.K14: 三级柜：废物处理后才出柜
points.S1: 新装、移位后，先检测再用

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台生物安全柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课专讲生物安全柜。
overlay: 生物安全柜的三个级别

shots.scene: 一、二、三级三台柜子图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three cabinet icons in a row: an open-front cabinet, a cabinet with a front window, and a sealed glove-box style cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 它分一、二、三级，各不相同。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着实验室里两台外形不同的安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at two different biological safety cabinets in the lab, puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现，实验室里的安全柜不一样。

shots.scene: 阿杰问小研，小研笑着拿出空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks a question; the female graduate student smiles and takes out a blank cabinet manual.
shots.narration: 小研说：级别不同，护的东西也不同。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：护人、护环境、护样品
shots.scene: 生物安全柜正面，前窗半开
shots.prompt_en: Front view of a biological safety cabinet with its window at the marked height and a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜，是一种生物防护设备。
overlay: 生物安全柜：护人、护环境、护样品

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：护人、护环境、护样品
shots.scene: 三个盾牌：人、地球、样品管
shots.prompt_en: Three shields protecting a person icon, a globe icon and a sample tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它能护人、护环境，还能护样品。

shots.scene: 三台柜子按密闭程度从开放到全封闭排列
shots.prompt_en: Three cabinet icons arranged from fully open front to fully sealed. No people.
shots.narration: 按提供的防护水平，分成三级。

shots.scene: 一级柜：前面敞开，没有下降气流
shots.prompt_en: A simple class one cabinet with an open front and no downward airflow, beside a lab coat, gloves and goggles icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先看一级柜。

shots.scene: 盾牌挡在人形图标前，排风口有过滤器
shots.prompt_en: A shield in front of a person outline, and a filter on the cabinet exhaust. No people.
shots.narration: 它保护操作者和环境。

shots.scene: 柜内样品旁飘进室内的灰尘点
shots.prompt_en: Dust dots from room air drift into the cabinet and land near an open culture dish. No people.
shots.narration: 但室内空气直接流过样品，

shots.scene: 样品管图标上出现污染点，旁边一个叉
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube icon with contamination dots and a red X beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 所以它不护样品，样品可能被污染。

shots.section_title: 一级柜：前面敞开，向里吸风
shots.scene: 剖面图：空气从前面开口被吸进柜内
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a class one cabinet: room air flows in through the open front, away from the user. No people.
shots.narration: 一级柜前面敞开，空气向里吸，
overlay: 一级柜：前面敞开，向里吸风

shots.section_title: 一级柜：前面敞开，向里吸风
shots.scene: 空气经过顶部过滤器后排出
shots.prompt_en: The air passes through a filter at the top before being exhausted. No people.
shots.narration: 经过过滤后再排出去。

shots.scene: 风险刻度上低到中段被点亮
shots.prompt_en: A risk scale from low to high with the low-to-middle section highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 一级柜一般用于低到中度风险的工作。

shots.scene: 两排生物危害标志：国际 4 组最危险，国内第一类最危险
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of four biohazard warning signs: in the top row the darkest red is on the right, in the bottom row it is on the left. No people.
shots.narration: 注意：我国病原分类第一类最危险。

shots.scene: 挥发性试剂瓶和放射标志旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A volatile chemical bottle and a radiation warning sign next to a question mark and a cabinet exhaust duct. No people.
shots.narration: 挥发性化学品、放射性物质，看排风再定。

shots.section_title: 二级柜：最常用，三方面都护
shots.scene: 二级柜特写，前窗有标记线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a class two biological safety cabinet with a front window at a marked height. No people.
shots.narration: 二级柜是最常用的安全柜。
overlay: 二级柜：最常用，三方面都护

shots.section_title: 二级柜：最常用，三方面都护
shots.scene: 三个盾牌同时亮起
shots.prompt_en: Shields over a person icon, a globe icon and a sample tube icon light up together. No people.
shots.narration: 人、环境、样品，它都能保护。

shots.section_title: 二级柜：最常用，三方面都护
shots.scene: 小研在二级柜里操作培养物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab coat, goggles and gloves, works with cultures in a class two cabinet.
shots.narration: 我们平时做微生物实验，多用它。

shots.scene: 几台二级柜图标，排风箭头各不相同
shots.prompt_en: Several class two cabinet icons with different exhaust arrows: some return air to the room, one ducted to the roof. No people.
shots.narration: 二级柜又分不同的类型。

shots.scene: 气流比例、排风方式两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a pie chart of airflow split, and an exhaust duct going outside. No people.
shots.narration: 区别在气流怎么走、排风排到哪。

shots.section_title: 二级柜：过滤加气流，保持无菌
shots.scene: 剖面图：过滤后的空气从上往下吹
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a class two cabinet: filtered air flows down over the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤后的洁净气流从上往下吹，
overlay: 二级柜：过滤加气流，保持无菌

shots.section_title: 二级柜：过滤加气流，保持无菌
shots.scene: 前窗吸入气流和下降气流一起流进格栅
shots.prompt_en: Front inflow arrows and downward arrows meet and enter the front grille. No people.
shots.narration: 前窗吸入的风挡住外面的空气，

shots.section_title: 二级柜：过滤加气流，保持无菌
shots.scene: 排风经过滤器排出
shots.prompt_en: Exhaust air leaves through a filter at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 排风也过滤，柜内保持无菌。

shots.scene: 风险刻度中到高段被点亮
shots.prompt_en: A risk scale with the middle-to-high section highlighted next to a class two cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 二级柜适用于中到较高风险的工作。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白目录和评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank catalog book and a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 具体能做什么，查国家目录、看评估。

shots.scene: 柜体侧面的空白铭牌特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a blank nameplate on the side of a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 用之前，先看铭牌认柜型。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白铭牌和说明书之间对照
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares the blank nameplate with a blank manual.
shots.narration: 是几级、什么类型，排风接没接管道。

shots.scene: 老周在旁指点：不确定就问
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at the cabinet and explains to the young male student.
shots.narration: 柜型不清楚，就问负责人，别凭感觉。

shots.section_title: 新装、移位后，先检测再用
shots.scene: 老李和检测人员在柜旁放置空白检测仪器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sets up a blank testing instrument beside a newly installed cabinet.
shots.narration: 新装的柜子、搬动过的柜子，
overlay: 新装、移位后，先检测再用

shots.section_title: 新装、移位后，先检测再用
shots.scene: 柜上贴空白合格标签，绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank test certificate tag with a green check stuck on the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 要先检测合格，贴好标签再用。

shots.section_title: 新装、移位后，先检测再用
shots.scene: 日历和柜子图标，循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon and a cabinet icon with a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 平时也要按规定定期检测。

shots.scene: 三级柜：全封闭的手套箱式柜
shots.prompt_en: A fully sealed glove-box style class three cabinet with two glove ports. No people.
shots.narration: 三级柜是最安全的一种，

shots.scene: 三个盾牌最大最亮
shots.prompt_en: Large glowing shields over a person icon, a globe icon and a sample tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 对人、环境和样品，防护都最高。

shots.scene: 柜子被一圈厚墙完全包围
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the sealed cabinet surrounded by a thick wall, no air arrows escaping. No people.
shots.narration: 用于最危险的生物因子，

shots.scene: 柜内和柜外之间一道实线分隔
shots.prompt_en: A solid line separating inside the cabinet from the room outside. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内与外界完全隔离。

shots.section_title: 三级柜：手套口和传递窗
shots.scene: 手伸进手套口的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of hands inserted into the glove ports of a sealed cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 操作时，手伸进手套口，
overlay: 三级柜：手套口和传递窗

shots.section_title: 三级柜：手套口和传递窗
shots.scene: 侧面传递窗，两道门不能同时打开
shots.prompt_en: A pass-through box on the side of the cabinet with two doors, one closed while the other opens. No people.
shots.narration: 物品经传递窗进出，两道门不同时开。

shots.section_title: 三级柜：废物处理后才出柜
shots.scene: 废物袋在柜内封好，再进入灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A sealed waste bag inside the cabinet moving into an attached autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里的材料和废物，
overlay: 三级柜：废物处理后才出柜

shots.section_title: 三级柜：废物处理后才出柜
shots.scene: 处理后的废物从柜子另一侧出来，绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: Treated waste comes out the other side with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 都要封装、处理后才能拿出来。

shots.scene: 手套口特写，手套上有一处小破口
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a glove port with a small tear in the glove, highlighted with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 手套是这种柜子的薄弱处。

shots.scene: 小研戴防护手套检查手套口，看有无破损老化
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing her own gloves, inspects the glove ports for tears and wear before use.
shots.narration: 用前检查有无破口、老化，

shots.scene: 手套口挂空白停用牌，小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: A blank out-of-service tag hangs on the glove port; the female graduate student reports to the older man.
shots.narration: 有问题就停用、报告、按程序更换。

shots.scene: 阿杰调整座椅高度，视线平对前窗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student adjusts his chair so his eyes are level with the cabinet window.
shots.narration: 用安全柜，先调好座椅，

shots.scene: 双臂平稳伸入，物品放在柜内中后部
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's arms rest steadily inside the cabinet; items are placed toward the middle and back.
shots.narration: 手臂平稳伸入，东西放中后部。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和伸展手臂的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon and a person icon stretching their arms. No people.
shots.narration: 做久了，告一段落再休息。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁三台柜子图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three cabinet icons that light up one by one.
shots.narration: 一级护人和环境，不护样品；

shots.scene: 二级柜和三个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A class two cabinet icon with three shields. No people.
shots.narration: 二级最常用，三方面都护；

shots.scene: 三级柜和手套口
shots.prompt_en: A sealed class three cabinet icon with glove ports. No people.
shots.narration: 三级完全隔离，防护最高。

shots.scene: 铭牌、合格标签、两排标志三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a nameplate, a test certificate tag with a check mark, and two rows of biohazard warning signs. No people.
shots.narration: 认柜型、看检测，记住国内分类方向。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在二级柜前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye in front of a class two biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 选对柜子，用对方法，下次见！
